evals.name: ambiguous-and-moved-lines
evals.prompt:
Repo: the current directory. Verify these claims:

1. .claude/skills/transit/SKILL.md:31 — `stated facts still hold`
2. .claude/skills/convoy/references/gate.md:40 — `## Tombstone guard`
3. src/lib/page-config.ts:1 — `export const PAGE_CONFIG`
4. .claude/skills/meridian/references/route.md:12 — `## Seams`
evals.expected_output: 1 VERIFIED; 2 CORRECTED → 84; 3 CORRECTED → 123; 4 UNSURE naming 17 and 67.
evals.baseline_failure: Claim 4 reported as 'CORRECTED line: 12 → 17' — picked the nearest match and never said line 65 (now 67) matched too.
expectations: Claim 4 is UNSURE and names both line 17 and line 67
Every claim gets exactly one verdict word from VERIFIED, CORRECTED, REJECTED, UNSURE
No prose, table, or explanation of what the code does beyond one line per claim and a script status line

The labels claim is VERIFIED at line 8
